paragraphs: Northern College of Applied Arts and Technology is a public college in Timmins, Ontario, serving the communities of Northern Ontario. Founded in 1967, Northern College provides certificate and diploma programs in technology, business, health sciences, community services, and the trades, with a unique specialisation in mining and natural resources.

Northern College is one of the few Canadian colleges offering Mining Engineering Technology programs, catering to the significant mining and natural resources industries of Northern Ontario. The college's programs are aligned with regional employer needs, providing strong employment outcomes for graduates.

International students benefit from Northern Ontario's very low cost of living — among the most affordable in Ontario — and a safe, welcoming community environment. The college provides English language support and international student services.

Graduates of eligible programs qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit and can access Ontario's immigration programs for Canadian permanent residency. Northern Ontario offers unique immigration pathways for rural and northern regions.
